# Security Policy

## Scope

This policy covers the `@fundkeep/sdk` transaction-building and submission helpers. Wallets own signing; the SDK must never receive private keys.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report transaction-construction, argument-encoding, RPC-handling, dependency, or unintended-signing risks privately through GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** flow. Include impact, a minimal reproduction, SDK version, and network details.

Never include private keys, seed phrases, access tokens, or signed production transactions. We aim to acknowledge reports within a few business days.
